sentences.text:
Rajeshwar Yadav vs State Of Jharkhand ...Opposite Party on 15
May, 2024
Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 2339 of 2024
 Rajeshwar Yadav ...Petitioner

Versus
 State of Jharkhand ...

Opposite Party
 ---

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Tarun Kumar No.1, Advocate
 For State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, Advocate
For the informant : Mr. Anuj Kr. Trivedi, Advocate

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned
 counsel for the respondent State.

2.  The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gawan (Giridih) Case No.56 of 2023,
for the offence registered under sections 341, 323, 376, 313 of the Indian Penal Code and section 3/4 of Prevention of Witch (Daain) Practice Act, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Giridih.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is falsely implicated in this case and the alleged relationship is said to be in the year 1997 itself.

He submits that she has also implicated other persons on the false allegation of section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and those persons have faced the trial being the S.T. No. 226 of 2012 and they have been acquitted by the learned Sessions Judge, Giridih by the judgment dated 07.06.2018.
He submits that the falsely the petitioner has been implicated in this case.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that allegations are there.
5. Learned counsel for the informant submits that complaint case was filed and thereafter the same under section 156 (3) of Cr.P.C. for the initiation of the enquiry.
6. Looking into the contents of the complaint petition it is stated that the relationship was established in the year 1997 itself.
The informant was blessed with a child in the year 2000 and the present First Information Report is filed in the year 2023.

7.

In the attending facts and circumstances, I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
8.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today, and in the event of his surrender/arrest, the petitioner, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Giridih, in connection with Gawan (Giridih) Case No.56 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
